hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; tracked=$(git diff --numstat HEAD 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1+$2} END{print s+0}'); untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 cat 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); total=$((tracked + untracked)); if [ "$total" -gt 1500 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage":"Working tree con %s líneas sin commitear (umbral 1500). Considera /cerrar-trabajo."}' "$total"; fi
